description: This file defines a React component named ViewCostDetailsModal, which renders a modal overlay displaying detailed cost information, including a summary view and raw JSON. It manages state for user data, fetches user info asynchronously, and provides copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: fallbackCopy
methods.description: Fallback method to copy text to clipboard using a temporary textarea element.

methods.name: loadName
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches user name based on userId when modal opens or userId changes.
